about.title: Specialist care, without the wait
paragraphs: Aster was founded in 2016 to fix a specific problem: the gap between noticing something on your skin and seeing someone qualified to judge it. We hold urgent slots open every day for exactly that.
Medical dermatology, surgical excision, laser and cosmetic treatment all happen in the same rooms with the same specialists, so nothing gets referred out and lost.

whyChooseUs.title: What you can expect from us

items.title: Always a specialist
items.description: Never a registrar, never a nurse-led substitute.

items.title: Urgent slots held daily
items.description: If something has changed, we will see you this week.

items.title: Results by phone
items.description: Every biopsy result is delivered by a doctor, not a portal notification.

items.title: Photographic records
items.description: Baseline images mean next year's comparison is objective, not remembered.

items.name: Dr. Ify Okafor
items.bio: Ify leads the skin cancer surveillance programme and has a special interest in dermoscopy of difficult lesions.

items.name: Dr. Linh Tran
items.bio: Linh runs our laser and cosmetic dermatology service alongside a busy acne and rosacea clinic.

items.name: Total body photography
items.description: A 92-image baseline of your skin, so next year's check compares photographs rather than memory.

items.name: Digital dermoscopy
items.description: Polarised magnification with sequential imaging for lesions we want to watch rather than remove.

items.name: Dan Whitlock
items.quote: I called on a Tuesday about a mole that had changed. I was seen Thursday, it was excised the following week, and it was a melanoma in situ. I don't think I'd have got that anywhere else in under two months.

items.name: Sophie Marchetti
items.quote: Fifteen years of rosacea and three GPs. Dr. Tran changed one thing about my routine and it was noticeably better within six weeks.

items.name: Marcus Bell
items.quote: The baseline photographs are the thing. Last year's images sat on screen next to this year's and the decision took thirty seconds.

items.question: Do I need a referral?
items.answer: You can be seen without one, but a GP referral means you can claim a Medicare rebate on the consultation. We're happy to see you either way.

items.question: How long does a full skin check take?
items.answer: Around 30 minutes for a standard check, or 45 if you're having total body photography for the first time.

items.question: What happens if you find something?
items.answer: In most cases we can biopsy or excise the same day. Histopathology results come back within five working days and are always delivered to you by phone, by a doctor.
